patthana15.35:1.1: sāsavañceva nocaāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavoceva na anāsavoca na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.35:2.1: āsavañceva sāsavañca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavoceva na anāsavoca na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.35:3.1: sāsavañceva nocaāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na anāsavoceva na nocaāsavo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. āsavoceva āsavasampayuttadukaṃ navagocchakaṃ antarā lokuttarapariyāyena pañhe nalabbhatime pañca nahime natthi
patthana15.35:4.1: na sandissanti. āsavavippayuttasāsavaduka kusalattike āsavavippayuttanasāsavaduka nakusalattikaṃ
